AUTHOR: Sokolova
TITLE: A Deep Learning Approach to Assist Sustainability of Demersal Trawling Operations
REGION: Skagerrak, Denmark (RV Havfisken, Nephrops demersal trawl, 19 hauls of 1.5 h)
SPECIES: Nephrops norvegicus; round fish (cod, hake, saithe); flat fish (plaice, dab, lemon sole, witch); other (non-commercial fish, invertebrates, squid)
DATA: Own in-trawl footage (720p, 60 fps) from sediment-suppressing NepCon camera system; 4,385 annotated frames; two test videos (27,000 and 23,100 frames) + 9 whole-haul videos
V_EV: Sec. 2.5: one video 'referred to as "Towing", and the other with the higher occlusion rate and less stable observation conditions ... referred to as "Haul-back"'; Table A1 reports P/R/F per video
D2: 4,385 images split 88/12 train/val; test on two separate videos and 9 whole-haul videos
D_EV: no statement found (Sec. 2.1: 'The prepared dataset consisted of 4385 images and was split in train and validation subsets as 88% and 12%' — unit of split not stated)
R_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'To evaluate the algorithm performance, we have selected two test videos.' — same cruise, vessel, camera system and fishery; no external domain
C_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'The duplicate counts of the objects escaping from the top band of the frame were accounted for by introducing a filter in the top fifth rows of the frame.'
E_EV: Sec. 2.6: 'Predicted count for the whole haul was then compared with the manual count of the catch captured by the in-trawl image acquisition system and the actual catch count performed onboard the vessel.'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (ResNet-101-FPN, ImageNet-initialised, matterport Keras) + Copy-Paste/geometric/colour/blur/cloud augmentation + modified SORT (Kalman, Mahalanobis, matching cascade, class evidence vector, top-band exit filter)
METR: Track-level precision/recall/F-score; best F-score 0.79 ('Towing'), ~0.67 ('Haul-back'); absolute count error vs manual counts (Table 2, Fig. 7)
NOTE: pdftotext output is doubled (two overlaid layout layers) but readable. ENV coded NR: demersal trawl in Skagerrak matches no allowed value. TAXA coded 과/속 수준 because classes are coarse catch categories (Nephrops / round fish / flat fish / other), not species. V3 = illumination (artificial light, camera exposure/gain/colour temperature reported); turbidity/sediment only qualitative; V6 = P because performance is reported separately for 'Towing' vs 'Haul-back' (occlusion/stability strata) and count error is tracked by haul phase (sediment resuspension). Train/val split unit not stated; test videos are separate recordings but it is not stated whether training frames were drawn from the same hauls (D1 = NR). E5 = 독립 참조 because automated counts are compared with onboard catch counts (trawl catch), in addition to manual video counts; note onboard counts cover only commercial species in three of four classes, so the comparison is partial. C5 covers duplicate-count handling via SORT exit filter; no detection confidence threshold reported (C1 = NR). Test/count-comparison data public (DTU repository); training data on request.
